name: Chthonic-Bastion
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past towering mountain ranges, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Regular pulses leave the buried megastructure aimed at deep space, toward nothing catalogued. The pattern has repeated unchanged for the nine years anyone has listened.
The artifact market prices fragments from this world like scripture. Provenance papers are forged in three systems, badly.
